about: The hare's run: four poses of the body's own Run, a bound keyed on the paw targets (each paw planted for 0.1 of the cycle and carried back 0.22 m: about 2.2 m of ground a cycle, the body's stretch and tuck at 0.3 of the file's), side-on, down and up, at the kernel's run of 95 ms a tile (HUNTING 2: small prey flee at the run). Rendered airborne (one floor a cycle). The foot-slide limit is the wolf's 2 px for a quadruped's four-pose loop.
